agreement: Partition coordinated with /root/swift_snapshot_composition_independent before inventory work.

encoder_callee_charges.rule: Every materialized source-projected MIR slot has one unique role ID, exact source span and actual compiler type; movement/copy/use edges reference that ID instead of creating unenumerated copies. The callee return slot and by-value argument slot are included even when a caller also has its own distinct source slot.

external_exclusions.storage: InitialProfileBorrowV1 pointee and sole actual cache/control/WASI guard owners
external_exclusions.reason: borrow_snapshot arg.initial and bridge receiver references are charged, their owners are not copied by a reference

external_exclusions.storage: ValidatedSwiftReactor pointee, its boxed source payload and metadata buffer payloads
external_exclusions.reason: only actual reference/header/temporary slots are charged; no borrowed heap payload is copied
reference parameters/locals charged; FileIdentityV1::encode actual64-byte self copy is separately included as a callee parameter
next_block arg.transfer and slice/reborrow slots charged; the externally held4096-byte array is not an encoder-local array

external_exclusions.storage: writer call-expression Result<SnapshotViewV2,Error>, caller success/error patterns, and caller-owned view local/Option/moves
external_exclusions.reason: encoder::borrow_snapshot_v2::return-expression and its actual view literal are separate charged callee roles

external_exclusions.storage: writer view call-argument move, Result<SnapshotCursorV2,Error>, cursor caller local/Option/moves
external_exclusions.reason: encoder into_cursor arg.self, cursor literal and return-expression are separate charged callee roles

external_exclusions.storage: writer Result<Option<SnapshotBlockV2>,Error>, caller block/Option/pattern/byte-view locals, write/error/moves
external_exclusions.reason: encoder next_block return-expression, Option/block literal, and reference parameters are separate charged callee roles

external_exclusions.storage: shared string/byte literals, promoted immutable scalar/range constants and code
external_exclusions.reason: product call-site references and any materialized literal-array temporary slots are charged; immutable static pointees are outside the local source-storage model

external_exclusions.storage: private std/core helper body frames, allocator/unwind/ABI state and backend spills
external_exclusions.reason: all product source call-site slots are included; this inventory makes no physical-stack or whole-process claim

aggregate_rule: Do not add these inherited identity/shape sizes or the52/58 type-identity sums to E. This occurrence inventory replaces their encoder-local coverage. Reconcile caller-owned fields against the caller lane rather than adding EncoderCallerPlacesV2.
nested_call_rule: The bounded product-source call graph has no recursion. At most one invocation of each exact function source template is live. All64 function/closure source templates are conservatively retained in E; sibling calls and exclusive arms are summed, not assumed simultaneous. Internal callee argument/return slots and their caller's materialized temporary slots have distinct role IDs.
generic_rule: Buffer<T>::len/get/snapshot_inventory_v2 each has one reused source template. T alternatives are Signature, Type, Import, Function, Global, Export and Segment; both data/elements use Segment. Every charged generic slot has the same measured size/alignment under all seven actual substitutions; the template is charged once. No heap Vec payload is copied.
loop_rule: All range/iterator/Option/item/local slots are charged once per source declaration. Iterations, records, blocks, directory probes and byte counts do not multiply storage.
retained_lifetime_cuts: borrow_snapshot: external guard/proof/provenance owners survive; local provenance Option/Result/pattern and view literal/return end at return; caller view result/pattern then belongs to caller partition

into_cursor: owned view plus header h, proof/metadata references, usage/observation copies and four option arrays survive across nested bridge/word/inventory/get/put/validation calls; bridge locals die before next sibling call; E conservatively sums them anyway

record_word: external cursor/view/proof remain borrowed; metadata/source/span and selected branch references/arrays survive nested get/span/type/result helpers; eight entry arms are mutually exclusive; entry closure and final result closure are sequential

next_block: cursor/transfer references, base/at/filled survive loop; directory/source/record branches reuse their own slots; nested record_word frames end before bytes are acknowledged; block literal/Option/Result return occurs after loop locals' last use; caller-held block/result belongs to caller partition

runtime/provenance: scalar/digest/identity loops reuse iterator/item slots; optional WASI branch is exclusive with absence; FileIdentity encode nested self/array/iterator/bytes are exact typed roles and reused for four identities
